methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNDRR's publications catalog is a Drupal-based, server-rendered listing at www.undrr.org/publications. It sits behind a strict Cloudflare/WAF that returned HTTP 403 to the crawler User-Agent; the underlying HTML is not a JS SPA and is scrapable with a realistic browser User-Agent.

## PreventionWeb / API investigation
The brief called for finding a real PreventionWeb API. Findings (HONEST): api.preventionweb.net does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) and no public PreventionWeb publications REST endpoint or developer docs could be located. A separate UNDRR Datahub exists at data.undrr.org/api/json/, but it serves open datasets/statistics, not the publications document catalog, and it presented TLS certificate issues on probe. Therefore this source is characterized as an HTML url-catalog, NOT a rest-api.

## Search
The Drupal listing supports full-text filtering via ?search_api_fulltext={query} plus type/theme facets.

## Filters
Type, theme, region facets appear as URL parameters; treated as opaque params (no formal schema).

## Download
Cards link to /publication/{slug} record pages; PDFs are served from /media/ or /sites/default/files/ and exposed on the record page. Two-step crawl required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, date and type are in server-rendered HTML. No usable publications API; enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
HONEST: listing blocked by WAF to bot UA (403), not JS-SPA. No PreventionWeb API. Use a browser-grade User-Agent. Pagination ?page=N.
probeNotes: api.preventionweb.net -> DNS ENOTFOUND (no such host). data.undrr.org/api/json/ -> TLS cert error; identified as datasets hub, not publications catalog. www.undrr.org/publications -> WebFetch 403 (WAF); confirmed Drupal server-rendered via search. No real PreventionWeb REST API found -> family stays url-catalog.
